title: Patbingsu Red-Bean Shaved Ice
shortDescription: Fine shaved potable ice is topped with chilled sweetened red beans, pasteurized condensed milk, strawberries, mango, and optional small pieces of Korean rice cake.
culturalContext: Patbingsu centers shaved ice and sweet red beans, while modern Korean versions may add fruit, milk, rice cakes, cereal, or ice cream. This fruit-forward assembly preserves the red-bean core without claiming one definitive topping set.
author: {{LEGAL_NAME}}
equipment: Shaved-ice machine approved for food use
Chef’s knife and produce cutting board

ingredients.preparation: kept frozen and protected from contamination

ingredients.item: commercially prepared sweetened Korean red beans
allergenNotes: check label for soy, wheat/gluten, and facility cross-contact

ingredients.item: soft Korean injeolmi or plain rice-cake pieces
ingredients.preparation: cut into pieces no larger than 1 cm / 3/8 inch
allergenNotes: may contain soy powder or facility allergens; check label

instructions.heading: Sanitize and chill
instructions.action: Wash hands and clean the shaved-ice machine according to its manufacturer instructions. Place serving bowls in the freezer for 15 minutes.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Machine food-contact parts are clean and bowls are frosty.
instructions.safetyNote: Ice is ready-to-eat food; handle the machine and ice only with clean hands and tools.

instructions.heading: Check packaged toppings
instructions.action: Read sweetened red-bean, condensed-milk, and optional rice-cake labels for allergens, pasteurization, storage, and date information.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Packages are intact, within date, and properly chilled after opening.
instructions.safetyNote: Use pasteurized dairy and do not serve unlabeled rice cake or red-bean products to allergy-sensitive guests.

instructions.heading: Wash and cut fruit
instructions.action: Rinse strawberries and the whole mango under cool running water, dry, then cut on a clean produce board. Refrigerate the cut fruit.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Fruit is clean, evenly cut, and cold with no bruised or moldy pieces.
instructions.safetyNote: Wash the mango before cutting so the knife does not carry surface contamination into the flesh.

instructions.heading: Prepare optional rice cake
instructions.action: With a clean knife, cut soft rice cake into pieces no larger than 1 cm / 3/8 inch; omit it for young children, older adults, or anyone with swallowing difficulty.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Pieces are soft, separate, and very small.
instructions.safetyNote: Chewy rice cake is a choking hazard; use small pieces, supervise eating, and omit for higher-risk diners.

instructions.heading: Shave and assemble
instructions.action: Shave potable ice directly into the chilled bowls. Immediately top each with one-fourth of the red beans, condensed milk, strawberries, mango, and optional rice cake.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Ice is fine and snowy, toppings are evenly distributed, and no liquid pools before service.
instructions.safetyNote: Use only the machine's pusher, never fingers or utensils near moving blades.

instructions.heading: Serve immediately
instructions.action: Serve at once with clean spoons and instruct diners to mix lightly as they eat.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Ice remains fluffy rather than melted into soup.
instructions.safetyNote: Do not refreeze melted bowls or save partially eaten servings; discard them after service.

grillSetup: Not applicable; this dessert uses a cleaned food-approved shaved-ice machine and freezer-chilled serviceware.
visualDonenessCues: Ice is fine, clean, and snowy
All toppings are cold and label-checked
Rice-cake pieces, if used, are soft and very small
foodSafetyNotes: Treat ice as ready-to-eat food and use only potable water and sanitized equipment.
Use pasteurized condensed milk and commercially prepared sweetened red beans with intact labels.
Wash whole fruit before cutting and refrigerate cut fruit promptly.
Chewy rice cake is a choking hazard and should be omitted for higher-risk diners.
Serve immediately; never refreeze melted or partially eaten bowls.

allergens.crossContactWarning: Contains dairy and may contain soy or wheat/gluten through packaged red beans or rice cake. Verify every label and use a cleaned ice machine and topping utensils.

substitutions: Use a verified dairy-free condensed milk only after reviewing its soy, nut, and gluten allergens.
Omit rice cake rather than substituting another chewy topping for diners with swallowing risk.
ingredientSourcing: Choose a commercial sweetened red-bean product with a complete ingredient and allergen label.
Use bagged ice labeled for consumption or freeze potable water in clean covered molds.
makeAhead: Chill opened toppings and prepare fruit up to 4 hours ahead. Clean the machine and freeze bowls before service; shave ice only at assembly.
storage: Do not store assembled patbingsu. Refrigerate separate opened toppings according to labels and use cut fruit within 2 days under this draft pending review.
leftovers: Discard melted or partially eaten bowls. Store only untouched toppings that remained within safe temperature control and clean service conditions.
servingSuggestions: Serve one chilled bowl per person
Offer optional rice cake only after assessing choking and allergen risks

faq.question: Can I refreeze melted patbingsu?
faq.answer: No. Discard melted or partially eaten bowls; refreezing damages texture and does not reverse handling contamination.

faq.question: Why use commercially prepared sweetened beans?
faq.answer: They provide a labeled, ready-to-eat component and avoid introducing an unvalidated raw-bean cooking process into this assembly recipe.
